name: Kingdom Hearts
overview: Kingdom Hearts is a critically acclaimed action role-playing game (RPG) series developed and published by Square Enix in collaboration with Disney. Directed by Tetsuya Nomura, the franchise is famous for its unique crossover universe that blends classic Disney and Pixar characters with figures from Square Enix properties like Final Fantasy, alongside its own original characters.
